editor_reconstruction_note: Sun's radiating rays fade into curved white lobes that converge into a thin line joining the sun to Earth; Earth label cross-fades with ghosted overlap at f46 from 'UN-SUN-SPECTING EARTH' to 'UNINHABITABLE EARTH'; Earth gets a white glow; figure's head highlight fades.
Small '1m' dimension marker (two arrows with tick) appears just left of Earth at the beam tip; Earth shading darkens slightly. Single-frame onset.

Hard cut to near-black canvas: large white stick figure with big circle head upper-centre; white labels with arrows 'DNA' 'FATTY ACIDS' 'BLOOD' 'MITOSIS' 'CELLULOSE'; glowing white beam entering from left edge at mid-height.

Beam widens into a full-width horizontal white band through the middle; stick figure replaced by dispersing white particle clouds above and below; label words scattered into individual letters (D N F Y A C I S T ... M B L O S E) flying outward.
Red scribble/marks appear on many of the scattered letters in both the upper and lower groups; band and particles unchanged.
White particle-physics style diagrams (branching arrows; small labels like e gamma Z0 W+ W- nu mu; mostly small unreadable at tile scale) appear above and below the band among the particles.
Hard cut to dark grey space: large glowing white sun disc with soft halo upper-centre; small grey-shaded Earth lower-centre; no text.
Hand-lettered white text '~1.5·10^22 J/day' appears just above the small Earth.

Two text items appear in one frame: '~3.8·10^26 J/second' above the sun and a small centred note '"VISIBLE" LIGHT, WHICH ONLY MAKES UP ~50% OF THE SUN'S ENERGY OUTPUT, BUT A FACTOR OF 1/2 IS NOT GOING TO SAVE US HERE' mid-canvas (tiny at tile scale).

Hard cut to close-up of Earth's limb: grey disc lower with Africa and Madagascar silhouette in darker grey; darker atmosphere band with white cloud shapes; tiny moon right; dark grey space above. No beam yet.
Thin vertical white beam from top edge to atmosphere appears with small glow spot at impact point; clouds otherwise unchanged.

Red glow appears at impact point and clouds dim; hand-lettered label 'MILLIONS OF DEGREES (FAHRENHEIT, CELSIUS, RANKINE, OR KELVIN - IT DOESN'T REALLY MATTER)' with curved leader line appears left (small at tile scale).
Semi-circular white bubble labelled 'PLASMA' with red outer glow appears at impact point replacing the clouds beneath beam.
Plasma region widens into a scalloped-edge pale area across the atmosphere band; red wavy arrows radiate outward labelled 'X-RAYS' (red text) and 'MORE PLASMA' (black text) appear.
Red wavy arrows extend across the whole atmosphere band left and right and a red tint spreads; small red label 'IR' (INFERRED from tile) appears at left of the plasma; atmosphere band turns pink.
Atmosphere band turns white-hot with red band; surface layer torn with black debris specks; Earth landmass turns red; labels and arrows removed; moon remains right; debris thrown upward at impact.
Hard cut to a zoomed-out full Earth globe on black with a wider soft beam from top hitting its top; red glow at point; white label 'RIP' with curved arrow pointing at impact.
White label 'SAFE?' with curved arrow pointing at the lower right of the globe (far side) appears.
Red word 'NOT' appears above 'SAFE' and the question mark becomes a red exclamation mark; globe surface pattern also looks shifted versus G0037 (INFERRED slow rotation; UNRESOLVED).
Three tiny white outline objects (look like small cups or teeth; identity UNRESOLVED) appear at the bottom edge of the globe near the 'NOT SAFE!' arrow.
Hard cut to dusk landscape: purple-to-pink gradient sky with stars, brown ground; centred grey tombstone reading 'RIP' / 'CAUSE OF DEATH:' / 'TWILIGHT'; small grass tufts.

Over six frames the scene slides left: 'TWILIGHT' tombstone exits left while a second tombstone 'RIP CAUSE OF DEATH: MOONLIGHT' enters from right and centres; a half-lit moon appears upper right by f1203.

Hard cut to Earth globe (upper half lit grey with continents; lower half dark) inside a darker ring halo; six white arrows pointing down from top; tiny stick figure on top of globe; tiny figure at lower right; label 'TWILIGHT' lower right; grey gradient at top.
White zigzag scatter-path lines appear throughout the halo ring around the globe among the arrows.

Lit half of globe goes dark; arrows, zigzags and 'TWILIGHT' label removed; background gradient gone; white beam with red glow now strikes top of globe where the small figure stands; halo ring remains faint.
Glowing red-pink arc with small white arrows and red outward arrows appears hugging the top of the globe around beam impact, spanning a short arc.
Red arc extends further down both sides of the globe; more outward arrows. Single-frame step.
Red arc extends further down both sides; step change.
Red arc extends further below equator on both sides; halo ring and small marker removed.
Red arc extends further toward the bottom of the globe.
Arc extends again; gap at bottom narrows.
Arc closes to a complete red ring around the globe.
Hard cut to close-up of limb: pink-white glowing atmosphere, Earth surface tinted pink with Africa silhouette in dusty red; thin beam from top with red point.
Black debris specks and rock-like fragments appear above the surface and across the sky; surface edge becomes ragged; short white streaks at impact.
Red zigzag ray lines appear radiating from the impact across the surface (reflected infrared).
Hard cut to small half-lit globe with halo ring at left-centre; moon right; tiny figures at top and bottom of the globe; soft white haze at top; dark grey below.
Lit half of globe and haze go dark; moon dims; white beam with red glow appears at top figure; halo faint.
White arrows radiate from impact point leftward and rightward; a bright line goes from impact to the moon which lights up; red glow around impact; camera/composition slightly shifted up (INFERRED).
Arrows fan out from the moon back toward the globe's bottom figure with a red line to bottom; moon position shifts slightly right.
Bright white-red arc appears over top of globe with red spark bursts at its ends.
Arc extends further down both sides.
Arc extends further; gap at bottom narrows.
Arc closes into a complete glowing ring; sparks gone.
Hard cut to red-tinted ruined landscape: broken tombstones labelled 'TWILIGHT' and 'MOONLIGHT' with flying debris; white glare streaks from upper left; moon upper right; dark red ground.
Hard cut to dark space: bright white sun upper-centre with long vertical beam running down from it; small grey Earth lower-left with white motion lines.
Earth is now at the beam, turned red and pinkish with a red glow at beam contact; sun and beam shifted slightly.
Earth now to the right of the beam, scarred red with a red trailing glow; beam rises behind it; sun smaller/higher.
Hard cut to close-up of large red-and-grey damaged Earth on black with grey debris particles at upper-left; no beam.

Seven-frame dissolve: grey slab base appears, then a tombstone fades in over the Earth which desaturates from red to grey and shrinks to sit beside 'RIP'; tombstone text 'WE SHOULDN'T HAVE TURNED THE SUN INTO A LASER' appears.
